claim_text: In children with NF1 and symptomatic plexiform neurofibromas treated with selumetinib, 28 of 50 patients (56%) had a durable partial response lasting at least 12 cycles (approximately 1 year).
notes: Full text (PMC7305659). Single-arm phase 2 (n=50, stratum 1 only), unblinded central MRI volumetry; capped at 3 because there is no randomized control (RCT/strength 4 criteria not met). | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. Durable response subset of C0009. Same RTX-KG2 edge applies.
source_title: Selumetinib in Children with Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas
